doc: Autonomy settings for a new org. Changed only by a PR merged on green checks (agent review; never a person); the tick reads it, never writes it. See docs/bootstrapping.md#autonomy. Gated actions on surfaces an agent's shell can reach list their harness_deny rules, mirrored in .claude/settings.json (tests/test_policy.py).

interrupt_gate.rule: Pause only when an action is irreversible AND identity-bound AND has no engineerable reversible path. Engineer reversibility first (backup, branch, draft, preview, canary), then proceed.
examples: sign or file a legal document
destroy data that has no backup
send a message outside the org on the owner's behalf
create or rotate a credential only the owner can mint

closed_loop.rule: Assume nothing is ever read, reviewed or decided by a person and that no external input arrives. Every loop closes itself; every artifact has a consuming loop or is not produced; documents and memories are not storage; blockers are resolved by building the capability.
closed_loop.enforced_by: python3 -m foundation closedloop --check (Ultrastable core); metrics orphan_artifacts and human_wait_states, target 0

standing_limits.doc: These always win over trust, rung or policy. A refusal is stated plainly with its reason and recorded; it is never re-routed around.
limits: the agent harness's own permission checks
the secret lock: no agent reads, prints, commits or moves a secret; secrets live only in the platform secret store
consent, suppression and opt-out for any outreach
the owner's override, always honored and recorded
another session's live claim on an item

trust.widens: only the fleet's own loop scopes, by PR to this file

meaning.observed: agent proposes; a reviewer agent executes and records
meaning.assisted: agent executes in a branch or preview; a reviewer agent merges
meaning.delegated: agent executes and merges after a different agent's review passes
meaning.autonomous: agent executes, merges on green checks, reviewer audits after
meaning.self-directed: agent also chooses its own next items from the driver
meaning.self-modifying: agent may open PRs to its own role file and this policy (merged by review)
meaning.self-extending: agent may propose new roles, surfaces and connectors (merged by review)

ladder.transitions_act_by: PR to autonomy/policy.json, opened by the operations role, reviewed by a different agent

runtime.doc: Workers, D1, KV, R2, queues on the org's Cloudflare account.

deploy_production.reversible_path: versioned deploy with rollback; canary first

migrate_destructive.reversible_path: export the table to R2 first, then it is reversible

internal_chat.doc: Reports to the owner and the org's own channels.

outreach.doc: Email, forms, social, anything a person outside the org receives. Kill switch and caps are data in outreach/gate.json; opt-outs in outreach/suppression.json always win.

send_from_org_mailbox.reversible_path: rate caps, suppression list, dry-run default and kill switch bound the blast radius; each message is guard-checked and logged before it leaves

secrets.doc: Credentials. Agents never see values. Naming a secret binding in config is a repo edit (repo surface); setting a value is the owner's.

growth._doc: GROWTH-PM-1 (owner 2026-11-12): the product manager's job is growth, not only bug fixes. Enforced values: foundation/growth.py --check fails when a product has fewer than min_metrics_per_product growth metrics, no owner loop in the loop registry, or when growth_share_floor differs from doctrine/growth.json target_growth_share. The executor prefers growth items while the recent merge mix is below the floor (growth.prefer); a runtime that keeps an issue queue multiplies the score of growth items by growth_priority_weight.

standing_order.rule: CODE-ONLY-ORDER (Rowan, 2026-11-16): chat threads, sessions and reports are temporary and are never storage. Every decision, instruction and standing rule lives in the system itself as code the system consumes: the seed, agent instructions, doctrine and policy files, checks and loops. A rule that exists only in a thread or a report does not count. Agents decide on their own, implement, deploy to production and verify live; they never present a decision to the owner. A merged change that records a decision with no code consumer, or an agent report that hands a decision to the owner, fails a check and files a work item.
standing_order.enforced_by: python3 -m foundation standingorder --check (checks.yml and the fleet pass); a decision with no code consumer or a report that hands a decision to the owner fails and files a Q-ORDER item
